title: An explicit construction of two completely independent spanning trees in the four-dimensional dual-cube
summary: Lalou, Mbarek, Skender and Togni (arXiv:2607.25917) proved that the $n$-dimensional dual-cube $F_n$ admits two completely independent spanning trees for every $n\ge 5$, observed that none exist for $n\le 3$, and identified $F_4$ as the first unresolved case, reporting more than 700 hours of inconclusive computation. We settle this case affirmatively by an explicit construction, completing the classification: $F_n$ admits two completely independent spanning trees if and only if $n\ge 4$.
